answer_1.quote: We empirically show that incorporating MSR into chemical LLMs and general LLMs both lead to consistent performance improvements in three molecular tasks: molecule-to-text, retrosynthesis, and text-to-molecule.
answer_1.outputs: textual molecule descriptions (captions) and SMILES/SELFIES strings

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance by comparing the generated description with the ground truth using six metrics: BLEU2, BLEU4, ROUGE1, ROUGE2, ROUGEL, and METEOR. For molecule generation we use BLEU, Exact, Levenshtein, MACCS FTS, RDK FTS, Morgan FTS, Fréchet ChemNet Distance, and validity.
